abacus.definition: a tool with beads used to show numbers and help with counting or math

activity.definition: something a learner does as part of learning

add.definition: To put numbers together to find how many there are in all.

addition.definition: the math process of putting numbers together to find the total

aloud.definition: Aloud means saying something so it can be heard.

amount.definition: how much of something there is

answer.definition: The result you get after solving a problem.

application.definition: A computer program used to do a task.

arithmetic.definition: basic math with numbers, like adding and subtracting

arrange.definition: To arrange means to put things in a certain order.

before.definition: Before means earlier or coming first.

box.definition: A small square space where you write a number or answer.

chalkboard.definition: a board teachers write on with chalk

chapter.definition: one main section of a book

circle.definition: to draw a round line around something

circles.definition: Round shapes that can be shaded or counted.

closed shape.definition: a shape with lines that join all the way around and have no opening

coin.definition: a small flat piece of money made of metal

compare.definition: to look at two or more things to see how they are alike or different

count.definition: to say numbers in order to find how many there are

curriculum.definition: the subjects and lessons planned for learning in school

diagram.definition: A diagram is a picture used to show information or objects.

difference.definition: the answer you get when you subtract one number from another

digit.definition: any whole number from 0 to 9 used to write numbers

draw.definition: to make a picture or a line with a pencil or pen

equal.definition: Equal means being the same in number or amount.

equals.definition: A word that shows two amounts or expressions have the same value.

example.definition: something that shows how to do a task or understand an idea

exceeding.definition: going above a number or limit

exceeds.definition: is greater than or goes above

exercise.definition: A set of practice questions for learning or testing a skill.

fill.definition: To put in the needed number or information in an empty space.

finger.definition: one of the parts on your hand, often used for counting

flat.definition: level and not raised; in geometry, a shape that is not solid

fruit.definition: a food that grows on plants or trees, like an orange or a banana

group.definition: a number of things put together

horizontal.definition: Going from left to right across a page.

horizontally.definition: in a side-to-side way, with numbers written across

ICT.definition: A short form for Information and Communication Technology, which means using computers and other technology tools.

identify.definition: to find out what something is or point it out correctly

introduction.definition: the beginning part that explains what a book or lesson is about

kite.definition: a plane figure with two pairs of equal sides; it can also mean a toy that flies in the wind

largest.definition: Largest means the greatest in size or value.

line.definition: a long mark made on paper

match.definition: to connect two things that go together

missing.definition: Missing means something is not there and needs to be filled in.

missing number.definition: A missing number is a number that must be found to make a math sentence correct.

money.definition: Coins or notes used to buy things.

number.definition: A number is a symbol or word used to show how many or how much.

numeral.definition: A numeral is a symbol used to write a number, like 4 or 27.

object.definition: An object is a thing that can be seen or counted.

ones.definition: the place value for single units from 0 to 9

order.definition: Order is the way things are placed, such as from first to last or smallest to largest.

oval.definition: a round shape like an egg, with no corners

pentagon.definition: a plane figure with five sides and five corners

picture.definition: an image or drawing that shows something

place value.definition: the value of a digit based on where it is in a number

practice.definition: To do something again and again so you can get better at it.

previous.definition: coming before the one you have now

principle.definition: a basic rule or important idea

quantity.definition: the amount or number of something

question.definition: something that asks for an answer

read.definition: To read a number means to say it correctly in words.

recognise.definition: to know or identify something when you see it

recognising.definition: knowing or identifying something when you see it

rectangle.definition: a plane figure with four sides and four corners; opposite sides are equal

regrouping.definition: a way of adding when a place value makes a new ten that must be moved to the next place

remain.definition: Remain means to be left after some things are taken away.

remainder.definition: A remainder is the amount left after taking away or subtracting.

remained.definition: was left after some were taken away, used, sold, or broken

represent.definition: To represent means to show something in another way, such as with pictures or numbers.

revision.definition: work done to review and practice what has already been learned

rotten.definition: spoiled and not good to eat

row.definition: A row is things placed in a straight line.

screen.definition: the part of a device where words or pictures appear

sequence.definition: numbers or things placed in a special order, one after another

sequentially.definition: in an order that follows one after another

shade.definition: To color in a shape or circle to show an answer.

shape.definition: the form of something, such as a circle, square, or triangle

shilling.definition: A unit of money used in Tanzania.

skill.definition: the ability to do something well through learning and practice

smallest.definition: Smallest means the least in size or value.

sold.definition: gave something to someone in exchange for money

solution.definition: the answer to a problem, or the way to solve it

space.definition: An empty place where an answer should be written.

square.definition: a plane figure with four equal sides and four corners

star.definition: a shape with points sticking outward

subtract.definition: To subtract means to take away a number or amount from another number or amount.

subtraction.definition: Subtraction is taking away one number or group from another to find how many are left.

sum.definition: the answer you get when you add numbers together

syllabus.definition: a list or outline of what will be taught in a course

take away.definition: Take away means to remove some objects or a number from a group.

tens.definition: the place value that counts groups of ten

total.definition: the whole amount when numbers or things are added together

trace.definition: To trace means to draw over lines or dots to make a shape or number.

triangle.definition: a shape with three sides and three corners

understand.definition: to know the meaning of something

unit.definition: one single thing used for counting

vertical.definition: Going up and down on a page.

vertically.definition: in an up-and-down way, with numbers written one under another

whole number.definition: a number with no parts like fractions or decimals

withered.definition: dried up and became weak or dead

word.definition: A word is a group of letters that has meaning. Numbers can be written in words.

word problem.definition: A math question written in sentences about a real-life situation.

write.definition: To write a number means to put it down using words or symbols.

zero.definition: Zero means none or not any object.
